End-to-End.method: Per-case sum of Add, Index, Search, Answer, and Judge; excludes service startup and orchestration overhead.

notes.unselected_cases: Intentional case selection is not counted as skipped data.
notes.timestamp_validation: Accepts ISO-like YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD timestamps with an optional weekday and time.

observability_gaps: Provider-side prompt truncation is not exposed by the OpenAI-compatible endpoint; client-side truncation is recorded.
Human Judge review remains a manual field and is not auto-filled.
